title: [I17:E01] Activate Work Planner Style Model
body:
## Overview

Work Planner declares the heading steps, inline HTML invocations and linked contracts used by its converted documents. Its guidelines, rule mappings and source readers follow that installed model, so conversion-only declarations cannot mask a regression.

## Changes

The installed declaration defines the converted document families and supplies the model consumed by the checker and source readers.

### Installed Style Model

- **Declared document families.**
  Entry point sections, numbered heading steps, inline HTML commands, family preambles, Apply/Follow routing and linked artifact contracts are declared together.
- **Aligned guidelines.**
  Writing rules describe the installed structure and retain execution, prerequisites, checkout and ownership conditions.

### Source Reader Validation

- **One declaration authority.**
  Real-corpus readers select the installed model; synthetic controls state only their fixture declarations.
- **Meaningful source coverage.**
  Script reach, operation interfaces, fetched epic-base inputs and checkout propagation remain observable, with declaration-removal and literal-isolation controls.

## Overview

Work Planner loads common rules and conventions before mode selection and keeps deployed values in linked configuration sections. The shared checker validates heading procedures and HTML invocations for each selected model, using the same parser and contract ownership for citation and interface checks. Modes and protocols expose ordered heading steps and explicit artifact and procedure calls. Issue and body artifacts link accepted record shapes and execute their commands within ordered steps. Delivery, branch, pull-request, board, queue, planning and review artifacts expose linked contracts and execute commands in their owning steps.

## Changes

The epic base carries the declared-model checker capability, its acceptance/rejection specimens, Work Planner's common context files and its mode, protocol and artifact presentation under the installed Work Planner style declaration.

### Declared Models

  Explicit file entries select entry layouts; typed options describe heading steps, preambles, field contracts and call verbs.
- **Procedure contracts.**

- **Execution and interfaces.**
  Selected invocation models require executing-step placement, with GraphQL REST-gap evidence scoped there and Projects V2 checks preserved.

- **Argument classification.**
  Bold contract arguments are validated before ordinary Markdown links, preserving literal title-prefix filters and rejection of unsupported contract targets.

  `skills/work-planner/SKILL.md` selects modes after loading `rules.md` and `conventions.md`, preserving their operative conditions.
- **Configuration.**
  Board titles and fields, planning-record placement and the reporting default have one documented home; consuming sections select applicable configuration reads.
- **Reader ownership.**
  Guidelines and checkout-vocabulary validation use their declared homes and the installed Work Planner model.

- **Verification procedures.**
  Revise's named verification procedures hold HTML invocations and linked argument contracts with preserved command syntax and explicit examples.
- **Source readers.**
  Mode readers select heading steps and recognize Apply calls while preserving draft-publication, caller-coverage and epic-base assertions.

### Protocol Procedures

- **Ordered coordination.**
  Protocols use numbered heading steps, Rules/Conventions preambles and scoped flush conditions while preserving prerequisites, inputs, refusals and return points.
- **Layered invocation.**
  Artifact operations use Apply and whole-protocol calls use Follow, including repeated calls to existing required callees.
- **Evidence boundaries.**
  Literal-head and merged-revision instruments preserve the walked protocol bytes and test the actual source composition. Independent reading observations remain Partial; inherited prerequisite, receipt, authority and live-evidence limits remain recorded.

### Issue and Body Artifacts

- **Executing steps.**

### Board and Review Artifacts

  Board Queue owns Ready Units and Report Lines and links Lane's task-lane reading, unit-lane checks and report labels.

### Installed Work Planner Model

- **Family declarations.**

  Real-corpus readers use the installed declaration, preserving operation interfaces, script reach, fetched epic-base inputs, checkout propagation and literal isolation.
- **Evidence boundaries.**
  Complete-suite and final documentation-head checks retain their exact revision boundaries; bounded Revise observations remain Partial with over-reading, truncation and receipt limits recorded.

## Overview

Skills select their document model through structure declarations. The shared checker validates heading procedures and HTML invocations for the selected model, with Work Planner's installed adoption reserved for its final conversion task.

## Changes

The declared-model checks cover the proposed Work Planner presentation while its live documents keep their selected model.

### Declared Models

- **Structure selection.**
  Explicit file entries select entry layouts; typed options describe heading steps, preambles, field contracts and call verbs.
- **Procedure contracts.**
  Step sequences follow their parent procedure, and Inputs/Outputs resolve the owning artifact's field contracts.

### Invocation Reading

- **Literal command payload.**
  One lexical reader owns Markdown fences and HTML invocations, preserving shell text and required bold argument links.
- **Execution and interfaces.**
  Invocations sit in their executing step, with GraphQL REST-gap evidence scoped there and Projects V2 checks preserved.
